title: What Travis County's budget adds
subtitle: Selected new spending in the plan commissioners vote on Sept. 29
alt: Bar chart of selected new spending in Travis County's proposed budget, which commissioners are scheduled to adopt on September 29, 2026: 15 million dollars held in reserve for the county's mental health jail diversion programs, 2 million dollars for supportive housing services for residents at risk of returning to jail or homelessness, more than 2 million dollars earmarked for an expansion of the county's contract with Axon Enterprise that could pay for new security drones, and 1 million dollars for the county's juvenile justice program.
source: Travis County preliminary budget, via Austin Current
